0022600208.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-3, winners of their last two, 3-1 on the road) visit the Houston Rockets (7-2, first in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) for Denver's ninth game of the season, with Houston coming off a one-game losing streak. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 129-93 win in Denver in their last meeting.
